properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1331021

Nearest City: Cornwall, CN

Location2: INTERNATIONAL BRIDGE INTO THE ST LAWRENCE RIVER

SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 45.004639, -74.740869 (Approximated from street_address)
Report DescriptionREPORTS CONTRACTOR ON THE INTERNATIONAL BRIDGE DUMPED STONES INTO THE RIVER. THEY WERE CLEAN STONES. AT 200 AKWESANE INTERNATIONAL RD, CORNWALL ON CONTRACTOR IS BRONTE CONSTRUCTION SHOULD HAVE KNOWN BETTER. REPORTING PARTY STATED THEY HAVE A TRAVELLER SYSTEM, A RAILWAY CAR UNDER THE BRIDGE WAS INSTALLED. THEY HAD TO PUT WEIGHT ON IT 3000 POUNDS TO SEE HOW IT WOULD RUN. THE CONTRACTOR WAS UNLOADING THE STONE, SOME BAGS BROKE OPEN, IT WAS COLD OUT AND PROBABLY DIDN"T WANT TO DEAL WITH IT, SO THEY JUST OPENED THE BAGS AND LET THEM GO IN THE RIVER. THE RIVER IS THE ST LAWRENCE RIVER AND SOME WENT ON TO THE GROUND AS WELL. INTERNATIONAL PROPERTY SOME IN CANADA AND SOME IN US, THE US HAVE BEEN NOTIFIED. THE STONES ARE GONE IN THE RIVER ( UNRECOVERABLE) AND THE ONES ON LAND WILL BE PICKED UP. BRONTE CONSTRUCTION WAS SPOKEN TO AND WILL NOT DO THIS AGAIN. THIS WAS DONE ON MARCH 2, 2022, THREE DIFFERENT INCIDENTS: NORTH TRAVELLER AT 11:30 CENTRE TRAVELLER AT 13:30 SOUTH TRAVELLER AT 14:30 ENGINEER FIRM CAME TO INSPECT THE TRAVELLERS AND SEND IN PICTURES. FULL CAMERAS AND VIDEO OF THE INCIDENT. REPORTING PARTY NOTICED THE STONES IN THE PICTURES AND WENT BACK CHECKED VIDEO. HARBOUR SIDE ENGINEERING WITNESSED IT TOO. NOTIFICATION BECAUSE BRONTE CONSTRUCTION IS DENYING EVERYTHING. NO VISUAL IMPAIRMENTS TO ANYTHING IN THE WATER, WILDLIFE OR FISH WERE NOTICED.
